title: SIFMA-recommended US fixed-income early close, 2:00 p.m. ET — the last session of 2027, a full equity day carrying an OCC quarterly expiration with no New Year holiday behind it
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/guides-playbooks/holiday-schedule (SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 299,272 bytes), parsed out of the page's embedded payload because the 2027 tab is hidden from the rendered text. The US 2027 panel's final entry reads verbatim ['New Year's Day 2027/2028', 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, December 31, 2027'] — a TWO-field row with NO full-close date, where every other entry in the panel is three fields (heading, full-close date, early-close note). That missing middle field is itself the corroboration: NYSE's own holiday table, fetched direct the same session (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes), carries the 2028 New Year's Day cell as an em dash with footnote * reading verbatim 'Because the holiday falls on Saturday, January 1, 2028, no New Year's Day holiday is observed'. There is no full close to name, and SIFMA still recommends the early close in front of it. Contrast the same panel's 2026/2027 row, which IS three fields — ['New Year's Day 2026/2027', 'Friday, January 1, 2027', 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Thursday, December 31, 2026'] — the shape a normal year takes. Filed estimate on the same three counts as the sibling sifma-bond-early-close-2027-03-25 and sifma-bond-early-close-2027-12-23 entries: no confirmed prefix exists for a trade association's recommended schedule, this lane may not self-confirm an in-sweep discovery, and SIFMA's recommendations are advisory to member firms rather than a market-wide halt. Discovered during the christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24 initial research, checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24 initial research (2026-09-08). This date is the second of the two cross-asset asymmetries that session found in the 2027 year-end corridor, and it is the more unusual of the pair because THREE things land on it at once. (1) It is a FULL NYSE equity session: the exchange's early-close footnote names exactly one December early close across 2026/2027/2028 and it is 'Thursday, December 24, 2026', so December 2027 has no 1:00 p.m. ET session anywhere in it. (2) The OCC's own expiration calendar (www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes, fetched the same session) marks 2027-12-31 a 'Quarterly Expiration date' — the last-business-day-of-quarter marker it also carries on 2025-12-31, 2026-12-31, 2027-03-31, 2027-06-30 and 2027-09-30. (3) SIFMA recommends the bond tape shut at 14:00 ET. So the last session of 2027 runs a full equity day and a quarterly options expiration against a fixed-income market recommended closed two hours before the equity close — and unlike 2026, there is no holiday the next session to absorb it, because Saturday New Year is not observed. WHY THIS IS NOT THE SAME AS 2026: the 2026 year-end early close sits on Thursday 2026-12-31 in front of an OBSERVED Friday 2027-01-01 holiday (sifma-bond-early-close-2026-12-31 already tracks it). The 2027 one sits in front of nothing. WHAT IT CORRECTS DOWNSTREAM: any lane counting 'the last five sessions of 2027' gets December 27, 28, 29, 30 and 31 — five full equity sessions, none an early close — which is the configuration the fhfa-hpi-2027-12-28 ledger's session-count leg assumes; this entry is the evidence for the fifth of them, and the reason it is not a half day. IMPACT LOW AND STRUCTURAL ONLY: a recommended early close is not a halt, and no house playbook is calendar- or holiday-keyed (both playbook docs grepped this session: zero hits). HONEST LIMITS: 'rates' is an imperfect kind (EventKind has no market-structure member, same note as the sibling entries); whether CME keeps separate hours that afternoon is NOT asserted, no CME source was fetched; and the quarterly-expiration marker is recorded as an attribute of this date, not as a separate proposed event — this calendar tracks no quarterly-expiration class today, and inventing one is not this lane's call. Proposed as an estimate; an estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
